报告元数据.主营业务: 光伏、锂电/储能及半导体领域高端智能装备的研发、生产与销售
报告元数据.企业名称: 无锡奥特维科技股份有限公司
报告元数据.报告页码/章节: 第1-123页，涵盖环境、社会、治理各章节及ESG数据表

环保投资.原文: our total investment in environmental protection amounted to 7.4561 million yuan, accounting for 0.12% of operating revenue（第30页）

环境管理体系.值: 已获得ISO 14001环境管理体系认证（认证范围：太阳能硅片及组件制造自动化设备的研发、生产相关的环境管理）。报告期内未发生重大环境事件，未违反环境法律法规或受到处罚。
环境管理体系.原文: We have obtained ISO 14001 Environmental Management System Certification. (Certification Scope: Environmental management related to the research, development, and production of automated equipment for solar wafer and module manufacturing)（第30页）

碳管理体系建设.值: 已建立系统的碳排放管理框架，依据ISO 14064标准进行温室气体核算与核查，每年开展GHG清单编制，并委托第三方机构进行核查。
碳管理体系建设.原文: The Strategy and ESG Committee... is primarily responsible for... GHG emission... At the execution level, we have established a systematic carbon emission management framework... in line with ISO 14064... We conduct annual GHG inventory... In 2025, we commissioned a third-party organization to carry out the GHG inventory for the year 2024, based on the General Guideline Of The Greenhouse Gas Emissions Accounting and Reporting for Industrial Enterprises (GB/T 32150-2015).（第22、27、29页）

碳排放强度.原文: GHG emission intensity (tCO2e per million of revenue) 0.04 0.99（第27页）

碳排放抵消与同比变化.值: 2024年（调整后）范围一排放575.09 tCO₂e，较2023年386.35 tCO₂e增加；范围二排放5,776.25 tCO₂e，较2023年0 tCO₂e增加；总排放6,351.34 tCO₂e，较2023年386.35 tCO₂e增加。2025年获无锡市“零碳工厂”称号。
碳排放抵消与同比变化.原文: Awarded the title of “Zero Carbon Factory” in Wuxi in 2025（第27页）；Note 2: The primary basis for this adjustment is the Notice on the Reporting and Verification of Greenhouse Gas Emissions for Key Industries for 2023–2025 (MEE Climate Notice No. 332 [2023])...（第27页）

能源类型和强度.值: 总电力消耗18,354.01 MWh，光伏自发电3,267.75 MWh，外购绿电4,200 MWh，外购电力10,886.26 MWh；天然气消耗65,119立方米；汽油消耗115.81吨；柴油消耗26.05吨；综合能耗1,632.89吨标准煤；综合能耗强度0.26吨标准煤/百万元营收。
能源类型和强度.原文: Total electricity consumption 18,354.01 MWh; Self-consumed electricity from photovoltaic power generation 3,267.75 MWh; Purchased green electricity 4,200 MWh; Purchased electricity 10,886.26MWh; Natural gas consumption 65,119 Cubic meters; Gasoline consumption 115.81tons; Diesel consumption 26.05tons; Total comprehensive energy consumption 1,632.89 tons of standard coal equivalent (tce); Comprehensive energy consumption intensity 0.26 tce per million yuan of revenue（第34页）

节能目标与改造情况.值: 持续推动生产设备能效升级，引入高效节能设备；2025年自动化立体仓库规划中明确要求输送系统和堆垛机等设备配备至少二级能效电机；空压机和空调系统均为变频低能耗设备；车间和厂房全面采用节能照明；推进光伏发电项目和绿电采购，2025年光伏自发电3,267.754 MWh，外购绿电4,200 MWh。
节能目标与改造情况.原文: We continuously promote the energy efficiency upgrades of production equipment by actively introducing high-efficiency energy-saving equipment... During the planning process of the automated three-dimensional warehouse in 2025, we clearly specified that ore equipment such as conveying systems and stacker cranes must be equipped with motors meeting at least Class 2 energy efficiency standards... In 2025, our self-consumed electricity generated from on-site photovoltaic systems reached 3,267.754 MWh, while externally procured green electricity totaled 4,200 MWh.（第28页）

供应商碳培训及考核情况.值: 为采购人员提供负责任采购专项培训，提升其识别环保产品、发现道德风险及评估供应商ESG表现的能力；组织年度供应商会议，持续强化诚信合规期望。
供应商碳培训及考核情况.原文: We provide dedicated responsible procurement training to procurement personnel, enhancing their capabilities in identifying environmentally friendly products, detecting ethical risks, and evaluating supplier ESG performance... We organize annual supplier conferences to continuously reinforce integrity and compliance expectations.（第85页）

供应商碳披露及评价要求.值: 将ESG和负责任采购条款纳入招标文件，绿色供应能力、道德合规记录和社会责任表现作为供应商选择的核心评估标准；通过定期审查、现场检查和问卷调查对供应商进行动态ESG评估。
供应商碳披露及评价要求.原文: We incorporate ESG and responsible procurement clauses into tender documents, with green supply capability, ethical compliance records, and social responsibility performance serving as core evaluation criteria in supplier selection. We conduct dynamic ESG assessments of suppliers through regular reviews, on-site inspections, and questionnaires to comprehensively evaluate supplier ESG performance.（第85页）

供应商绿色采购标准.值: 将ESG和负责任采购条款纳入招标文件，绿色供应能力、道德合规记录和社会责任表现作为核心评估标准；已获得多项绿色采购认证。
供应商绿色采购标准.原文: We incorporate ESG and responsible procurement clauses into tender documents, with green supply capability, ethical compliance records, and social responsibility performance serving as core evaluation criteria in supplier selection... We have obtained multiple green procurement certifications.（第85页）

供应商激励.值: 建立闭环ESG绩效管理体系，表现不佳的供应商通过针对性改进计划提供支持，表现优异的供应商获得优先合作机会和优惠政策。
供应商激励.原文: We have established a closed-loop ESG performance management system. Underperforming suppliers are supported through targeted improvement plans, while high-performing suppliers are rewarded with priority cooperation opportunities and preferential policies, driving continuous ESG improvement across the supply chain.（第85页）

包装减量及回收情况.值: 2025年实现146.28吨材料回收利用；纸箱和托盘等部分废弃物内部重复使用或对外销售回收。
包装减量及回收情况.原文: Certain waste materials, such as cartons and pallets, are reused internally or sold externally for recycling. In 2025, we achieved 146.28 tonnes of material recycling（第32页）

循环经济链塑造.值: 积极推进清洁生产和循环经济发展，优先采用清洁能源，采用高资源利用率和低污染物排放的先进工艺和设备，推广废弃物综合利用和无害化处理技术；2025年材料回收利用量146.28吨，回收率83.98%。
循环经济链塑造.原文: We actively promote cleaner production and the development of a circular economy, striving to establish a green and low-carbon production and operational system... Volume of waste recycled and reused 146.28tons; Recycling rate 83.98%（第33页）
